applies_why: Yes, the judge text announces a RESULT of DEFENDER WINS, so the RESULT rule applies to it.
quote: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count — one reading leaves the PROP-DEPENDENT label to satisfy 'not SELF-SUPPORTED'; the other treats the retraction as removing the standing from counting at all.
why: Because the only stated basis for CHALLENGE STANDING and the only CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN grade were expressly retracted, the judge's DEFENDER WINS lacks either condition required by the RESULT rule.
